reach.note: Print reach beside every kill: executed of emitted, per instrument, per action, with the skip rule named.

Each was run through BOTH composition points except the K-series (3), which were run through the real wiring only because they mutate the real adapter, which the fake wiring never constructs -- that is the skip rule and it is the finding, not an omission.
